$comment: The guided demo path as data, run by src/guided/GuidedPath.svelte (step logic: src/guided/steps.js). Each step names one thing to do and advances only when the app shows it done: there is no Next or Back, only 'Leave tour'. Each step has an id, a title (2–4 words), a one-line instruction (`line`: an imperative first, at most one clause of why; its action is marked [[like this]], shown in the accent color, exactly once), `done` (the app state the instruction produces; the step advances on its own once it holds, and a step already done when the tour reaches it is skipped), an optional `hint` (text shown while its `when` holds and `done` doesn't), and an optional `action`: a button in the strip that does the step's action, or opens what it needs. Conditions: songLoaded {song}, played (Play pressed since the song loaded), keyChosen {tonic, mode}, keyCommitted, chordAt {bar, beat, numeral}, tutorReplied. Actions: loadSong {song}, press {within, name} (a button by its accessible name inside an element id), openChords {bar, beat}, audition {bar, beat, numeral}, askTutor {lesson} (the question from content/lessons/plan.json; the server replays content/lessons/recorded/<lesson>.json when it exists). Bars and beats are checked against the song by tests/guided/steps.test.js. Stream I scripts video from it. Matthew owns this wording; revised drafts by Claude, Oct 7, 2026, for action and concision.

steps.title: Open a tune
steps.line: [[Load Ode to Joy]]; its key starts hidden, so your ear finds it.

steps.title: Hear it
steps.line: [[Press Play]] and hum along; notice where it wants to stop.

steps.title: Find home
steps.line: [[Choose the note the tune settles on]]. Not sure? Help me find it.

hint.text: Does it settle there? [[Press Check it by ear]] and try each chord again.

steps.title: A question at bar 4
steps.line: [[Put V under the long note in bar 4]]; hear it ask a question.

steps.title: Lean toward the end
steps.line: [[Put V under the first note of bar 8]], the 2 of '3 2 1'.

steps.title: A chord that swerves
steps.line: [[Put vi under the last note]]; hear the ending turn sad instead of home.

steps.title: Now let it land
steps.line: [[Swap the last chord for I]]; bar 4's question gets its answer.

steps.title: Ask why
steps.line: [[Press Ask the tutor]] to hear why the ending lands now.
